title: Tube Laser Cutting Machines, Ø0.3″ to 25″, Canada | NovoTech
meta_description: Every tube laser NovoTech sells: Dener E-FTL and FTL to Ø25.2″, NovoTech's own ULT two- and three-chuck lasers to Ø14.2″, Senfeng from Ø0.5″ to 49 ft bars.
h1: Tube and profile laser cutting machines — Ø0.3″ to 25.2″, 20 to 49 ft bars, 1.5 to 40 kW
intro: A tube laser cuts round, square, rectangular and open profiles to length and cuts the holes, copes, slots and notches in them in one pass — no saw, no drill, no notcher, no layout — straight from the 3D model. NovoTech sells three lines of tube lasers in Canada, each on its own page: the Dener tube lasers — the premium line, made in Turkey, the E-FTL with 1 G servo chucks for Ø0.3″ to 13.8″ and the heavy FTL for structural tube, pipe and beams to Ø25.2″ and 12 m bars of 2,600 kg; NovoTech's own ULT — the value line, two or three pneumatic chucks for Ø0.4″ to 14.2″ on 20 to 39 ft bars with 1.5 to 40 kW; and the Senfeng tube lasers — a value line under its own brand, from the Ø0.5″ two-chuck T series with 1.5 kW to the high-speed PLUS, the 45° bevel GT, the zero-tailing NT and the three- and four-chuck ST / HT machines to Ø25″, 6,600 lb and 49 ft. For trailer, railing, furniture, agricultural, HVAC and steel-construction work. Below, each line in brief and every model in one table of tube range, power, speed and bar length; every machine comes with a CSA-approved panel, chiller, tube nesting software, a 1-year warranty and installation, training and parts from Mississauga, ON, Canada.

NovoTech value line: ULT two- and three-chuck lasers Ø0.4″ – 14.2″, square to 13.8″, 20 – 39 ft bars to 2,205 lb, 1.5 – 40 kW
Senfeng value line: T, PLUS and 45° bevel GT lasers Ø0.5″ – 14″; NT zero-tailing, ST / HT three- and four-chuck lasers to Ø25″ and 49 ft
hero_brand_line: Dener Makina builds the premium lasers in Kayseri, Turkey (since 1974, Dener Canada in Mississauga, ON, Canada); NovoTech's own value line is built in China to our specification; Senfeng Laser builds its value line in Jinan, China (CE / FDA / ETL). All sold, installed and supported in Canada by NovoTech.

faq.q: Dener, NovoTech or Senfeng — which tube laser should I buy?
faq.a: Dener's E-FTL and FTL are the premium machines — Turkish-built, 1 G servo chucks, Precitec heads, ±0.05 mm, Dener Canada parts in Mississauga, ON, Canada — for the shop that runs the tube laser all day on precise work. NovoTech's own ULT is the value line we build to our specification: two or three pneumatic chucks for the Ø0.4 to 14.2″ tube most shops cut, at the lowest price of the three. Senfeng's tube lasers are a value line under their own brand: a 6 m two-chuck machine with a 1.5 kW source costs a fraction of a premium tube laser and cuts the railings, frames and furniture tube most shops run, and the range goes where few others do — zero-tailing three-chuck machines, four-chuck machines for 49 ft stock, Ø25″ pipe and the H-beam profile line. We quote all three so you can compare.

faq.q: What can a tube laser cut?
faq.a: Round, square, rectangular, oval and open profiles — angle, channel, flat bar — in mild steel, stainless, aluminum, copper and brass, from the chuck's minimum to its maximum size, in wall thicknesses to about 1/2″ (12 kW) or 3/4″ (20 kW). Holes, slots, copes for tube-to-tube joints, tabs and notches for folding, engraving — anything you can draw on the surface of the profile. A 5-axis or 45° bevel head adds weld preparations and mitred corners.

Two chucks (Dener E-FTL / FTL, NovoTech ULT, Senfeng T / PLUS) hold the bar at both ends and cover tube to Ø25″ — the machine most shops need. A third chuck in the middle (NovoTech ULT three-chuck, Senfeng NT) takes over the bar as it shortens, so the last part is cut without a tail. Three and four chucks on the heavy machines (Senfeng ST / HT) carry 49 ft bars of 6,600 lb without sag for structural sections and towers.

From a bundle: the automatic loader separates one bar, measures it and feeds it to the rear chuck; the front chuck and following supports hold the bar as it is cut; finished parts drop onto the unloading table or conveyor and the remnant is ejected. One operator runs the machine while loading the next bundle. Loading lengths of 7, 9 and 12 m — or manual loading on the small Senfeng T series.

The CNC imports STEP / IGES solid models of the tube parts, unfolds them onto the profile, nests them along the bar to use the remnant and writes the program — with the cutting database for the material and seam detection to orient welded tube. Offline programming on a PC is standard on both lines.

A 7 m machine needs about 20 m (65 ft) of length including the loader and unloader; a 12 m machine about 30 m. 600 V 3-phase with the supplied transformer or 480 V, a chiller (included), assist gas and a dust collector. We lay the machine out for your building before you order.

faq.q: What voltage do these machines run on?
faq.a: Three-phase machines are supplied for 600 V as standard with a CSA-approved panel; 208 V, 240 V and 480 V 3-phase are available on request, and 240 V single-phase on models with a small enough motor. Manual machines have no electrics.
